title: Match admin brands to the Expo catalogue
summary: Offer all 17 Expo brands and identical logos in the product editor and show registry-backed logos on website product details.

changes.detail: Expose the 17 existing Expo brands in the shared catalogue, using exact copies of their PNG artwork for the website and admin.
Admin no longer starts with only ASICS. Preserve existing product names, new-brand creation and saved logo overrides; hide failed admin images.
Website product details display shared brand logos with text/offline fallback. Explain product-save behavior in the picker.

validation.name: Focused checks
validation.detail: Pending regression, lint and type checks. Authenticated save/upload, visual device checks and production deployment have not been performed.
